text:
olivia: quick note  running a small experiment proposal: batch fallback notifications into an operator inbox item with runbook link instead of immediate alerts. want feedback.

ben: sounds promising. key is to preserve context: route, sample_rate delta, primary trigger tag, and recent deploys.

maria: yes  also include a one-click "view related deploys" that filters the rollout timeline. avoids manual correlation.

ashwin: implementation note: we can emit a single aggregated event per window with counts per trigger tag. that lets UI show top reasons and a per-tenant breakdown.

leah: UX: inbox item should have three states: muted (low impact), suggested-slack (grouped digest), and urgent (open pager). microcopy: "Automatic fallback applied: 5% -> 25% (window: 10m). Top signals: upstream-5xx, kv-cache-miss."

sam: telemetry fields needed: event_id, route_id, tenant_id, sample_from, sample_to, window_mins, triggers[], top_trace_id, deploy_ids[], explainability_summary (optional). Keep trace pointer small.

olivia: add an explicit field: "human_action_required": bool so we know when to open a pager vs. stash in inbox.

ben: policy schema tweak idea: allow annotation on policy with runbook_url and on_call_group so inbox items can pre-fill who to notify.

maria: privacy/security: ensure trace pointers are short-lived signed URLs when in private deployments. record only metadata in audit.

ashwin: ops-bot: can you drop a draft event spec with the aggregated counts + per-tenant split? also include an example of the inbox payload.

ops-bot: created draft at https://internal/specs/fallback-inbox-events.md. fields: event_id, ts, route_id, tenant_id, sample_from, sample_to, window_mins, triggers[], counts_by_trigger, top_trace_id, deploy_ids, runbook_url, human_action_required. Review: @leah @sam.

leah: small UI ask: let teams pin an inbox item to their route page and attach a short note. make pinning permissioned.

sam: add a metric: "fold_rate" to see how many inbox items were collapsed vs opened. helps tune thresholds.

maria: retention/export: default 60d for aggregated inboxes, but full audit rows still kept 90d. enterprise may increase. add export hooks to logs bucket.

olivia: action items:
- ashwin: prototype aggregated event emitter (counts_by_trigger) for staging routes by Fri
- ops-bot: add sample inbox payloads and paging rules to spec
- leah/sam: quick mock of inbox UI + pin flow by Tue
- maria: add security notes for signed trace links and retention policy

ben: one more: allow per-tenant opt-out where customers managing noisy traffic can disable auto-notify but still get audit rows.

olivia: good point. let's keep experiment small and measurable. will run on 10% of routes for two weeks. thanks :raised_hands:
